title: Saturn Is The Only Planet That Would Float
description:
Saturn is the only planet in the Solar System that is less dense than water, by about 30 percent. It has an average radius about 9 times Earth's and is over 95 times more massive. Together, Jupiter and Saturn hold 92 percent of the total planetary mass in the Solar System. (The bathtub is a thought experiment: Saturn is a gas giant.)

Source: Wikipedia, 'Saturn'.
